summary: Iteration 53 - Workshop Enrichment Features Testing Complete. All 20+ features working correctly across 3 phases: Phase 1 (Core tools), Phase 2 (Business tools), Phase 3 (Advanced features). Backend: 28/28 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All enrichment UI elements verified working.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - cosmetic only, existing issue from previous iterations
Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement opportunity

critical_code_review_comments: Phase 1 Core Tools: Notes API works with add/get, Checklist supports 5 templates (laptop/desktop/phone/printer/network) with toggle and custom items, Photos support before/during/after types, Audit trail logs all actions

Phase 2 Business Tools: Quote builder creates line items with subtotal/tax/total calculations, Send quote marks status as 'sent', Approve quote marks status as 'approved', Customer notifications send with template types, Device intake updates condition/accessories/warranty/password/email fields, Push to invoice creates new invoice or adds to existing

Phase 3 Advanced: Repair history lookup by serial/customer/phone, QR code generation returns PNG image, PDF job card generation with branding/checklist/notes/parts/billing, Workshop queue returns kanban columns (checked_in/diagnosing/parts_ordered/repairing/ready_for_pickup)

Frontend: Workshop detail view has 7 tabs (Notes/Checklist/Photos/Parts/Quote/History/Audit), 6 header action buttons (Notify/Intake/Quote/Invoice/PDF/QR), 6-stage progress tracker bar, Billing summary shows parts+labour correctly, Labour timer with start button, Update Status with all stage options
seed_data_creation: Existing workshop job WS-1001 has test data: 2 notes, 31 checklist items (from laptop template), 1 part ($2398), intake data (condition: fair, accessories: Charger + Bag/Case, warranty: expired)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 complete - Workshop Enrichment Features verified. Key navigation: Tickets page → Workshop (2) filter tab → Click WS-1001 or WS-1002 card. WS-1001 has existing test data. Key data-testids mentioned in agent context (ws-back, ws-notify-btn, ws-intake-btn, ws-quote-btn, ws-invoice-btn, ws-pdf-btn, ws-qr-btn, ws-note-input, ws-add-note-btn, ws-check-input, ws-load-template-btn, ws-photos-tab, ws-create-quote-btn, ws-save-quote, ws-timer-btn). Header has Workshop button to create new job with Customer Email field. Backend endpoints under /api/workshop/* prefix.

1_workshop_job_detail_view_loads.details: Detail view loads with all enrichment data - Notes(2), Checklist(1/31), Photos(0), Parts(1), Quote, History(0), Audit tabs. Shows job details, billing summary, labour timer, status buttons.

2_add_repair_note.details: POST /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/notes creates note with content/note_type/is_internal. GET returns notes sorted by created_at desc.

3_load_diagnostic_checklist_template.details: GET /api/workshop/diagnostic-templates returns 5 templates: laptop(15), desktop(15), phone(14), printer(14), network(13). POST with template param loads items.

4_toggle_checklist_items.details: PUT /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/checklist/{item_id} toggles checked state. Shows checked_by_name when checked.

5_add_custom_checklist_item.details: POST /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/checklist/add-item creates custom item with order at end of list.

6_upload_view_workshop_photos.details: Photos tab shows Before Photo/During Repair/After Photo upload buttons. GET /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/photos returns uploaded photos.

7_create_edit_repair_quote.details: POST /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/quote creates/updates quote with line_items/notes/tax. Calculates subtotal/total automatically.

8_send_quote_to_customer.details: POST /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/quote/send marks quote status='sent' and triggers notification.

10_push_workshop_to_invoice.details: POST /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/to-invoice creates new invoice with parts/labour line items or adds to existing invoice.

11_update_device_intake_fields.details: PUT /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/intake updates condition_on_arrival, accessories_received, customer_password, warranty_status, warranty_expiry, customer_email.

12_send_customer_notification.details: POST /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/notify-customer with notification_type (checked_in/quote_ready/ready_for_pickup). Logs notification history.

13_download_workshop_pdf.details: GET /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/pdf returns PDF with branding, job details, checklist, notes, parts, billing summary, signature lines.

14_download_qr_code.details: GET /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/qr-code returns PNG QR code image for job URL.

15_view_repair_history.details: GET /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/repair-history returns previous jobs matching serial_number, customer_name, or customer_phone.

16_view_audit_trail.details: GET /api/workshop/jobs/{id}/audit-log returns all action entries with action/details/user_name/created_at.

17_progress_tracker_bar.details: UI shows 6-stage progress bar: Checked In → Diagnosing → Parts Ordered → Repairing → Ready → Collected. Shows percentage complete.

18_workshop_queue_kanban.details: GET /api/workshop/queue returns jobs grouped by status columns: checked_in, diagnosing, parts_ordered, repairing, ready_for_pickup.

19_new_workshop_job_customer_email.details: Create workshop job dialog includes Customer Email field. POST /api/workshop/jobs accepts customer_email.

20_billing_summary_parts_labour.details: Billing Summary shows Parts total, Labour (minutes @ rate/hr), and Total. WS-1001 shows Parts: $2398.00, Labour: $0.00, Total: $2398.00.

mocked_apis.note: Customer notification email sending uses RESEND_API_KEY if configured (best-effort). Logs notification entry regardless of email send success.
